name: orgconnect
description: OrgConnect: a multi-organization platform for student orgs. Members RSVP and check in to events by QR code, log volunteer hours, book peer tutors, get certificates, message and chat in groups; officers manage events, members and announcements; a platform admin approves new orgs. React + Vite, Laravel 13 (Sanctum) REST API, MySQL, 130 automated test

paragraphs: A web-based platform for student organizations: events and attendance, volunteer hours, peer tutoring, members and announcements, for several orgs on one account. Group 4 · IPT (Integrative Programming and Technologies) · React + Laravel full-stack project. Supports SDG 4 (Quality Education, through peer tutoring and shared resources) and SDG 17 (Partnerships, by connecting students, officers and orgs).

whatItDoes.text: A web-based platform for student organizations: events and attendance, volunteer hours, peer tutoring, members and announcements, for several orgs on one account. Group 4 · IPT (Integrative Programming and Technologies) · React + Laravel full-stack project. Supports SDG 4 (Quality Education, through peer tutoring and shared resources) and SDG 17 (Partnerships, by connecting students, officers and orgs).

requirements.text: They cover sign-in and sign-up, officer vs member access, events and RSVPs, volunteer hours, peer tutoring, QR check-in, messages (with Seen and typing, group chats, photos and files), search, members and passwords, profiles, the paged lists, the feed, pending and inactive members, and registering a new org with the platform admin's review (backend/tests/Feature).
Sign up creates an account and an application to the selected org; an officer approves it.
